fai_logserver.description: FAI server hostname (FQDN); leave empty if not using FAI's savelog feature

fai_loguser.description: FAI system user for savelog; leave empty if not using FAI's savelog feature

mirrorurl.description: APT mirror URL for Debian packages

codenames.description: Space-separated list of Debian codenames to build FAI installers for

default_codename.description: Default Debian codename for iPXE boot menu (defaults to first in codenames)

archs.description: Space-separated list of architectures to build installers for

default_arch.description: Default architecture for iPXE boot menu (defaults to first in archs)

supported_locales.description: Space-separated list of UTF-8 locales supported in installer

rootpw.description: MD5- or SHA-512-hashed password for root account in installed devices
